name: Facet
text:
Build a live-updating dashboard that shows Playwright test results as they happen. The dashboard displays test names, statuses, and duration in real time, with color-coded rows for pass/fail/pending.

This gives the team instant visibility into test progress and failures, making debugging faster. The trade-off is that it requires wiring the dashboard to Playwright's event stream, which adds a small setup cost.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The live-updating dashboard risks drowning us in noise before we even see the signal. A better alternative is a *thresholded alert system*: only push updates when a test fails or exceeds a set duration, with a digest of recent changes. Settle it by running a 1-hour pilot comparing both—measure time-to-first-failure detection and noise complaints.
